title: Break the Pawn Wall
setup: Three pawns face three pawns on the queenside, and both kings are parked away in the far corner.
hint: Three abreast against three abreast. Give one away in the middle and count the tempi the other two need.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b6}} gives a pawn away to break the wall. After {{axb6}}, {{c6}} breaks through again: if {{bxc6}}, the a-pawn runs to a8 untouched, and if Black leaves it, {{cxb7}} and the pawn queens on b8. After {{cxb6}} instead, {{a6}} does the same job from the other side.

A pawn given up in the middle of three can buy a queen on the wing.
